note: Describes a dashboard and climate data feeds within one system, the national DHIS2; it states no exchange between health systems.

facts.fact: UNDP reports the mSupply eLMIS at the Gumbo Warehouse is interoperable with DHIS2, with an eLMIS dashboard integrated into DHIS2, and rolled out to 105 of 145 health facilities (72.4%).

systems.owner: UNDP with Global Fund support, Gumbo Warehouse

note: as_of is the document's published date (2026-03); it gives no event date.

facts.fact: The WHO and Ministry of Health assessment states DHIS2 runs at national and district level and that integration of health programme data into it is in progress, which it calls a gap in system unification and data interoperability.
